records.title: MCP-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Using LLM Agents with Complex Real-World Tasks via MCP Servers
records.reason: MCP-Bench is a benchmark for tool-using agents; its planning/concurrency metrics evaluate agent task behavior rather than improving LLM inference runtime.

records.title: Daily-Omni: Towards Audio-Visual Reasoning with Temporal Alignment across Modalities
records.reason: Daily-Omni introduces an audio-visual reasoning model and temporal alignment; no concrete inference efficiency mechanism or runtime result is presented.

records.title: The All-Seeing Project V2: Towards General Relation Comprehension of the Open World
records.reason: All-Seeing V2 focuses on open-world visual relation comprehension, not a direct inference-efficiency or serving technique.

records.title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
records.reason: WAM-TTT studies test-time steering of world-action models from human play; it is not a concrete LLM inference-serving optimization.

records.title: A Note on TurboQuant and the Earlier DRIVE/EDEN Line of Work
records.reason: The note compares TurboQuant-style product estimation with DRIVE/EDEN on error/recall and explicitly does not compare runtime; relevance is limited to cache quantization quality.
